'''Scott Wyngarden''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[March 2000 Wheaton tournament]] on 12 March 2000 with Obi's Hut / Careful Planning deck, according to Steve Kuperman's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d345">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-13-wheaton-illinois-3-12-2000d345/ wheaton-illinois-3-12-2000], DeckTech (Steve "Crazy Hermit" Kuperman, 13 March 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-13-wheaton-illinois-3-12-2000d345/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
